description: Presentation text for product changes in Pulse: a title, a summary and where to go. It never establishes that anything shipped. An entry appears only when the Git history the site is built from holds the pull request, squash-merged by GitHub onto the first-parent history, or the release tag, reachable from that history. Dates and commits come from Git; they cannot be written here.

features.title: Atlas map: a stable territory you can pin and share
features.summary: Publications keep their place on the map, published connections show their evidence, and a shared view records the dataset it was made from.

features.title: Evidence Matrix and five other working files reworked
features.summary: The Evidence Expectation Matrix keeps SP 800-53A methods, CCIs and STIG/SRG counts beside your own columns; implementation and inheritance worksheets follow the selected baseline.

features.title: Templates, Compare and Start Here go one step at a time
features.summary: One step indicator across the three guided flows, and each step waits for your choice before moving on.

features.title: Atlas starts with what you're working on
features.summary: RMF & ATO, STIGs & SRGs, Zero Trust, CMMC & CUI, FedRAMP and more: each gathers the publications, steps, templates and guides for that work.

features.title: Home shows what changed
features.summary: Accepted source updates and shipped features now appear on Home, each with its date and a link to where you can see it.

destination.label: See where source updates are recorded

releases.title: Control Atlas v1.0.2 released
releases.summary: The final v1 maintenance release: retired old link aliases, better Atlas map contrast and steadier mobile loading.
